paragraphs.source_zh: “嗯。”于义丸怡然自得地点点头。他偷偷看达姬一眼，又端正了姿势，道，“我们已经决定成婚。是吧，阿达？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Is… is that true, Tatsu?”

paragraphs.source_en: Lady Tatsu quietly lowered her head, her face radiant with joy and not at all flushed. Neither of them, most likely, had imagined what consequences would follow.

paragraphs.source_en: Blood rushed to Lady Taka’s head, leaving her dizzy. She barely managed to support her swaying body as cold sweat broke out all over her. Shame, astonishment, disappointment, fear… Alas, it was already too late for everything!
